newsitem.title: UK: Sainsbury, Willis launch home insurance.
newsitem.headline: Sainsbury, Willis launch home insurance.

text.p: Supermarket retailer J. Sainsbury Plc and insurance broker Willis Corroon Group Plc have launched a personal insurance scheme announced last month.

The two companies announced on January 10 they would be offering home and contents insurance, garden insurance and personal accident insurance to customers of Sainsbury's Homebase do-it-yourself unit.
The Homebase branded products are supported by a 24 hour, all year round helpline and offer a wide range of benefits, Willis Corroon said in a statement.
The garden and garden contents insurance cover is available as a stand-alone product, or as a part of a home and contents policy.
The service will be underwritten by a panel made up of Royal & Sun Alliance, Guardian Plc, Norwich Union, B.A.T Group Plc subsidiary Eagle Star and Lloyd's of London.
